newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Travel buys in Fuzhou toll bridges.
newsitem.headline: China Travel buys in Fuzhou toll bridges.

text.p: China Travel International investment Hong Kong Ltd has agreed to take a stake in a Chinese project to operate three toll bridges in China's Fu Zhou city, executive director Zheng Hongqing said on Friday.
"Total investment of the project itself is about 1.2 billion yuan and an agreement has been signed earlier," Zheng told reporters after the annual general meeting of China Travel.
CTS-Coastal Investment Ltd, a unit of the China Travel group, would take a 70 percent of the project with its Chinese partner owning the remaining 30 percent, he said.
Zheng did not give other details about the project.
China Travel and its parent China Travel Service (Holdings) Hong Kong Ltd hold a total of 51 percent interest in CTS-Coastal through China Travel Roads & Bridges JV Investment, the executive said.
The joint venture China Travel Roads, a 40/60 joint venture between China Travel and its parent, is an infrastructure investment vehicle of the group.
It took a stake in the Tianjin North Section of the Beijing-Shanghai Expressway in February.
